items.name: core
items.title: Chartory core
items.description: The Chartory chart engine: layout from the data at four sizes, Geist text metrics, SVG drawing, ChartView, motion.

items.name: theme
items.title: Chartory theme
items.description: Tokens for the Hearth collection in light, dark, Ember and Ember Light, chart colours and motion.
items.docs: Import the Chartory theme once in your global stylesheet: @import "../chartory.css"; (path from your globals.css to the project root). Charts use Geist: next/font's Geist exposes --font-geist-sans.

items.name: bars
items.title: Bars
items.description: One value per item, side by side. Sample data: monthly company card spend, January to September, 71K in July, September month to date.

items.name: grouped-bars
items.title: Grouped bars
items.description: A few series, side by side in each period. Sample data: new paid accounts per month by plan (Starter, Team, Business), July to December.

items.name: stacked-bars
items.title: Stacked bars
items.description: The total per period, and what it is made of. Sample data: failed payments per week by reason (card declined, insufficient funds, fraud block), W27 to W40.

items.name: diverging-bars
items.title: Diverging bars
items.description: In and out, from one zero line. Sample data: weekly inflow and outflow, W29 to W40, on a ±400K axis.

items.name: floating-range-bars
items.title: Floating range bars
items.description: A window per item, from start to end. Sample data: delivery windows of eight routes, R1 to R8, between 06:00 and 18:00.

items.name: histogram
items.title: Histogram
items.description: How values spread across ranges. Sample data: response times from 0 to 900 ms, P50 250 ms, P95 475 ms.

items.name: horizontal-bars
items.title: Horizontal bars
items.description: Items in a list, with room for their names. Sample data: parcels delivered at five hubs against the scheduled count, Rotterdam 1,312.

items.name: bullet
items.title: Bullet
items.description: Each number against its target. Sample data: four quarter-to-date measures, revenue $428K of $500K, orders 6,120 of 7,000.

items.name: lollipop
items.title: Lollipop
items.description: A slim bar with a marker at the value. Sample data: new deposits in four regions, South $596K, West $174K.

items.name: line
items.title: Line
items.description: One value, read as a trend. Sample data: P95 latency, us-east, last 24 hours.

items.name: area
items.title: Area
items.description: A trend with weight under it. Sample data: spot price, Sep 10 to Oct 9.

items.name: multi-line
items.title: Multi-line
items.description: A few series on one time axis. Sample data: P95 time to first token in four regions, last 24 hours.

items.name: overlapping-areas
items.title: Overlapping areas
items.description: A few volumes, seen through each other. Sample data: daily spot volume on three venues, Sep 10 to Oct 9.

items.name: streamgraph
items.title: Streamgraph
items.description: How the mix shifts through the year. Sample data: shipments by four modes, January to December, October at 47K.

items.name: forecast-band
items.title: Forecast band
items.description: Where it is heading, and how sure we are. Sample data: cash on hand, May to April, actual to October, P10–P90 band.

items.name: vertical-profile
items.title: Vertical profile
items.description: A value read down a scale, like a depth profile. Sample data: recall of Atlas 3 and Kite 2 Pro from 4K to 128K context, on a 60% to 100% scale.

items.name: donut
items.title: Donut
items.description: One total, split into a few parts. Sample data: monthly recurring revenue by plan, Enterprise $82K (45%), Starter $17K (9%).

items.name: semi-donut
items.title: Semi donut
items.description: A split under one headline number. Sample data: 3,412 orders by channel, web 52%, app 28%, market 14%, retail 7%.

items.name: polar-area
items.title: Polar area
items.description: Parts as wedges, sized by their value. Sample data: new trial signups by channel, organic 4.2K (30%), events 0.6K (4%).

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: Progress ring
items.description: How much of a quota is used. Sample data: 72% of the token quota used, 7.2M used, 2.8M remaining, resets in 9 days.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: One reading on a dial, with a limit marked. Sample data: fleet utilisation today, overload above 85%.

items.name: sunburst
items.title: Sunburst
items.description: Parts and their sub-parts, in rings. Sample data: $48.2K spend this month by team, research $20.2K, agents $3.0K.

items.name: radar
items.title: Radar
items.description: Two profiles across the same axes. Sample data: Atlas 3 and Kite 2 Pro scored on reasoning, code, math, tool use, speed and cost.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Two dimensions, shaded by value. Sample data: card transactions by weekday and hour over 7 days, the busiest cells at 398 and 412.

items.name: calendar-heatmap
items.title: Calendar heatmap
items.description: Every day of a season in one grid. Sample data: production deploys per day, last 20 weeks, May to September.

items.name: cohort
items.title: Cohort
items.description: How each group holds on over time. Sample data: monthly cohorts April to September, revenue retention, 86% to 91% at month 2.

items.name: cells-matrix
items.title: Cells matrix
items.description: Clusters across two sets of categories. Sample data: requests across 16 topics in code, support, search and agents, by size from 128 to 16K, one cell marked at 1,284.

items.name: hex-grid
items.title: Hex grid
items.description: Where clicks pile up on a page. Sample data: clicks on three key pages, product 16.1K, home 14.2K, checkout 8.3K.

items.name: tile-map
items.title: Tile map
items.description: Countries as equal tiles, shaded by value. Sample data: parcels delivered in 16 European countries, Germany 12.4K, Netherlands 10.1K.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Many parts in groups, sized by value. Sample data: net sales by subcategory in apparel, home, beauty and outdoor, shirts $84K.

items.name: sankey
items.title: Sankey
items.description: Where things come from and where they go. Sample data: sessions from four sources to four outcomes, search 4,200, purchased 2,100.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: How many make it to each step. Sample data: 48.2K site visits to 0.4K annual plans, 26% of visits sign up.

items.name: dot-strip
items.title: Dot strip
items.description: The full range per item, on one scale. Sample data: payout times for six rails, instant card 0.1 to 0.4 days, cheque 4.0 to 7.5 days.

items.name: scatter
items.title: Scatter
items.description: Two measures per item, as dots. Sample data: 30-day return against volatility for BTC, ETH and tokens in layer 1, DeFi and meme groups.

items.name: packed-bubbles
items.title: Packed bubbles
items.description: Items as bubbles, sized by volume. Sample data: spot volume by asset, ETH +5.8%, SOL −3.4%.

items.name: candlestick
items.title: Candlestick
items.description: Open, high, low and close, per period. Sample data: spot price in four-hour candles, Sep 30 to Oct 9.

items.name: gantt
items.title: Gantt
items.description: Who is busy when, lane by lane. Sample data: trucks at six docks from 06:00 to 14:00, loading, unloading, waiting and delayed.

items.name: block-timeline
items.title: Block timeline
items.description: Each team's items and their status. Sample data: items across core, growth, platform and mobile squads, shipped, in progress, blocked and planned.

items.name: network
items.title: Network
items.description: One hub and what it connects to. Sample data: one agent on Atlas 3 and its six tools, search 12.4K calls (32%), files 2.7K (7%).

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A release, its epics and their tasks. Sample data: release v4.2 (Dec 05), its epics and their tasks, each with a status colour (shipped, in progress, review, todo, blocked).

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: Tiers around a centre, with how active each is. Sample data: active wallets in four tiers, whales 42 (92% active), small 10.2K (64% active).

items.name: waterfall
items.title: Waterfall
items.description: Waterfall chart for React, in the Hearth collection (Signal with @chartory/signal).

items.name: box-plot
items.title: Box plot
items.description: The spread of each group in five numbers. Sample data: response latency of five models, Atlas 3 to Nova, on a 0 to 1.2 s scale.

items.name: slope
items.title: Slope
items.description: Before and after, one line per item. Sample data: store conversion by channel, September to October, email 4.1% to 5.2%.

items.name: bump
items.title: Bump
items.description: Who leads, week by week. Sample data: weekly trading-volume rank of five tokens, weeks 33 to 40.

items.name: bar-and-line-combo
items.title: Bar and line combo
items.description: An amount and a rate on one card. Sample data: new MRR by month, January to October, with monthly churn.

items.name: marimekko
items.title: Marimekko
items.description: Two splits in one block. Sample data: net sales by region (NA 38%, EU 30%, APAC 20%) and four categories inside each.

items.name: chord
items.title: Chord
items.description: Flows between peers, around a circle. Sample data: bridged volume between five chains, Base +$319M net in, Polygon −$146M net out.

items.name: parallel-coordinates
items.title: Parallel coordinates
items.description: Many items across many measures. Sample data: five models on accuracy, speed, cost, safety and context.

items.name: dot-plot-with-intervals
items.title: Dot plot with intervals
items.description: Estimates with how sure they are. Sample data: on-time delivery of six carriers with confidence intervals, against a 95% SLA.

items.name: spiral-year
items.title: Spiral year
items.description: A year of weeks, wound into one coil. Sample data: active workspaces per week over one year, with a 9-week streak above 2K.

items.name: radial-hour-heatmap
items.title: Radial hour heatmap
items.description: A week of hours around a clock. Sample data: deliveries over 4 weeks by weekday and hour, peak slot Thu 18:00.

items.name: order-book-depth
items.title: Order book depth
items.description: Buy and sell orders stacked away from the price. Sample data: an order book around a mid of 64,210.

items.name: horizon
items.title: Horizon
items.description: Many series, folded into thin rows. Sample data: daily volatility of four currency pairs against its average, Aug 11 to Oct 9.

items.name: ridgeline
items.title: Ridgeline
items.description: The shape of each group's spread, stacked. Sample data: response length of five models, Atlas 3 to Nova, from 0 to 2K tokens.

items.name: renko
items.title: Renko
items.description: Price, counted in fixed bricks. Sample data: spot price in $50 bricks, Sep 10 to Oct 9.

items.name: route-line
items.title: Route line
items.description: One route, stop by stop, done and to come. Sample data: one van's route, depot at 07:30 to depot at 11:40, now at Elm Park.

items.name: yard-map
items.title: Yard map
items.description: Every dock door and what is at it. Sample data: 12 dock doors and the yard, loading, loaded, reefer and waiting 2 h+.

items.name: shelf-planogram
items.title: Shelf planogram
items.description: Shelves, facing by facing, with stock levels. Sample data: three dairy shelves, 15 products from OAT to MOZZ, healthy, low and out of stock.

items.name: gains-curve
items.title: Gains curve
items.description: How much a model finds in its top picks. Sample data: a churn model, the top 20% of accounts hold 61% of churners.

items.name: event-barcode
items.title: Event barcode
items.description: Every event as a thin line, by service. Sample data: requests to chat API, embeddings and agents over 24 hours, OK, slow and error.

items.name: rate-dot-plot
items.title: Rate dot plot
items.description: Each member's view, year by year. Sample data: member views of the rate for 2026, 2027, 2028 and the longer run, between 2.0% and 4.5%.

items.name: likert
items.title: Likert
items.description: Agree and disagree, statement by statement. Sample data: five statements, easy to set up 12% disagree and 74% agree.

items.name: arc-diagram
items.title: Arc diagram
items.description: Flows between groups, as arcs on one line. Sample data: on-chain transfers between seven wallet types, from exchanges to miners.

items.name: ring-grid
items.title: Ring grid
items.description: One small ring per site, in a grid. Sample data: same-day dispatch at eight sites, Brno 99%, Ghent 89%.

items.name: dumbbell
items.title: Dumbbell
items.description: Two values per item, and the gap between them. Sample data: our price against the rival's for six outdoor products, gaps from −$10 to +$7.

items.name: marey-schedule
items.title: Marey schedule
items.description: Vehicles moving through stops, against the plan. Sample data: four vans through six stops from 08:00 to 12:00, Van 19 late.

items.name: icicle
items.title: Icicle
items.description: A breakdown in stacked rows. Sample data: inference spend by team and use case, support $18.4K (chat bot $11.2K, triage $7.2K).

items.name: venn
items.title: Venn
items.description: Who uses one, two or all three. Sample data: active accounts using dashboards (2,550, 71%), alerts (1,540, 43%) and the API (1,360, 38%).

items.name: uptime-bars
items.title: Uptime bars
items.description: Each day of each service, as a bar. Sample data: three services over 63 days, API 99.98%, dashboard 99.99%, webhooks 99.91%.

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume profile
items.description: Where the trading happened, by price. Sample data: spot price, Oct 8 to now, point of control at 150.5.

items.name: quadrant
items.title: Quadrant
items.description: Items in four zones that tell you what to do. Sample data: products by growth (−20% to +60%) and margin (0 to 60%), grow, protect, fix margin and review.

items.name: term-cloud
items.title: Term cloud
items.description: The words people use, sized by weight. Sample data: support conversations, 20 terms.

items.name: flame-graph
items.title: Flame graph
items.description: Where the time went in one run. Sample data: one agent run of 8.4 s, plan, research and answer, coloured by model, tool, retrieval and wait.

items.name: reconciliation
items.title: Reconciliation
items.description: Two lists matched line by line. Sample data: bank feed against ledger, NORDIC $9,100 against INV-4480 $9,000, a $35 bank fee with no match.

items.name: load-plan
items.title: Load plan
items.description: How full each truck is, and with what. Sample data: three trucks, Hamburg 92%, Bremen 88%, Kiel 81% full.

items.name: lorenz-curve
items.title: Lorenz curve
items.description: How evenly something is shared. Sample data: stake across holders, the top 10% hold 30%.

items.name: battery-cells
items.title: Battery cells
items.description: Charge per unit, like a row of batteries. Sample data: charge across eight vans, Van 22 at 18%, two vans charging.

items.name: milestone-track
items.title: Milestone track
items.description: How many reach each milestone, and when. Sample data: onboarding from signed up on day 0 (100%) to paid on day 14 (18%).

items.name: underwater-drawdown
items.title: Underwater drawdown
items.description: How far below the last peak, and for how long. Sample data: fund drawdown, January to October, max −16.5%.

items.name: context-ruler
items.title: Context ruler
items.description: What fills a model's context window. Sample data: context of four requests on a 128K scale, split into system, history, tools, docs and output.

items.name: age-pyramid
